tagline: A plush sofa bed with a waterproof liner that keeps a bad night out of the foam.
lead: Your dog gets a plush sofa bed to lean into, and accidents stop at a waterproof liner, not in the foam.
value: Plenty of beds are thrown out still sound but smelling. Here everything above the liner washes, and the foam stays protected beneath it.
intro: Elm is an XL orthopaedic dog sofa bed, 106.5 × 81.5cm, with cushioned sofa-style sides, a profiled egg-crate foam base, a plush sleeping surface, a waterproof inner liner and a removable, machine-washable cover.
points: Accidents and wet coats stop at the liner instead of soaking into the core.
Cushioned edges to lean against or rest a chin on.
A plush surface over egg-crate foam that spreads their weight rather than compressing flat.
It comes off and goes in the machine, following the sewn-in care label.
best_for: Dogs who like a sofa edge to lean on, in homes where wet coats and the odd accident are part of life.
fit_note: One size, XL. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm; the sides take up part of the footprint. Not sure? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Remove the cover and machine wash it following the sewn-in care label. Wipe the liner. Air-dry fully before refitting, and never wash or soak the foam.
